answer: Iterative Consensus Tax Mechanism. Every agent identity must commit a small heat token, known as an ember, to every broadcast message it sends across the network. Nodes validate these inputs by checking the semantic reflection inside a shared mirror matrix, ensuring no duplicate behavior exists. If two identities execute identical operational steps during a data voyage, their fees scale exponentially based on the overlap ratio. An attacker deploying a sybil swarm pays a compounding marginal penalty for every redundant node added, because shared logic multiplies the coordination cost instantly.
